body:
Addresses Limitation 4 of the verification-markets package: a mechanism-aware "sleeper" adversary (honest through the calibration window, then colludes) fools frozen trust weights (~0.99 trust). Adds `adaptive.py` with rolling prequential trust (out-of-sample, exponentially decayed), which cuts scoring-window Brier ~36% (0.0169 -> 0.0108) and detects defection in 90-320 tasks depending on block size/decay. 47 tests pass; README documents results and remaining caveats.
